external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor device installed on a customer site and publishing readings and polling for firmware updates.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside the organisation's physical control.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state whether field technicians are employees or third parties.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards
external_entities.notes: The source states that fleet operators use company SSO.

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts connections from sensor nodes and forwards accepted readings.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: The gateway is exposed to the internet. Sensor nodes authenticate with a fleet-wide pre-shared key.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them to the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network
processes.notes: The source does not state the normalizer's exposure or authentication mechanism.

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery
processes.notes: The source does not name the dashboard technology or its exposure.

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used by the gateway to check device keys and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to
data_stores.notes: The registry contains device authentication keys and customer associations.

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service onto which the gateway forwards accepted readings and from which the telemetry normalizer picks them up.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub
data_stores.notes: The source does not state the retention, encryption, or classification of messages.

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the telemetry lake in BigQuery. The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.
data_stores.notes: The lake contains customer data, including site addresses and occupancy patterns.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not state whether firmware images are signed or what encryption at rest is used.

data_flows.name: sensor node publishes readings to device gateway
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
data_flows.notes: Nodes authenticate to the broker with a pre-shared key. The key is per fleet, not per device, and has not been rotated since deployment.

data_flows.name: device gateway looks up device in device registry
data_flows.description: The gateway looks up a device in the registry to check its key and determine its customer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the gateway's authentication to Firestore or encryption in transit.
data_flows.data_description: device identity, authentication key, and customer association

data_flows.name: device gateway forwards accepted readings to Pub/Sub
data_flows.description: The gateway forwards accepted sensor readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the protocol, authentication, or encryption in transit.

data_flows.name: telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the protocol, authentication, or encryption in transit.

data_flows.name: telemetry normalizer writes readings to telemetry lake
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the BigQuery telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the protocol, authentication, or encryption in transit.

data_flows.name: sensor node polls firmware bucket
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the Cloud Storage bucket for a new firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. The source says: "I do not know whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it."

data_flows.name: field technician services sensor node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: Authentication is unknown: "I don't know what authentication that console has, if any."

data_flows.name: fleet operator views dashboard
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views dashboards from the corporate network using company SSO.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the dashboard protocol or encryption in transit.

data_flows.name: dashboard queries telemetry lake
data_flows.description: The dashboard accesses telemetry in BigQuery for fleet operators.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state the dashboard's separate authentication or encryption mechanism.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed and physically accessible to technicians.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites
trust_boundaries.notes: The sensor nodes are outside the organisation's physical control.

trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: expose to the internet because the nodes dial in from anywhere
trust_boundaries.notes: The gateway is exposed to the internet, but the source does not identify a separate process located in this boundary.

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE environment in which the MQTT device gateway runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: an MQTT broker we run on GKE
trust_boundaries.notes: The source does not describe other components in this boundary.

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the telemetry normalizer.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: a Python consumer in our analytics network
trust_boundaries.notes: The source does not describe the network's other controls or boundaries.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators view dashboards.
trust_boundaries.notes: Fleet operators authenticate with company SSO.

trust_boundaries.notes: This boundary groups the named managed cloud data stores; the source does not describe their specific network placement.
